1 Semiconductor Equipment Engineer (all genders) The SAL team is looking for a motivated and hands-on R&D Service Engineer to support our cleanroom team. At SAL MicroFab, we work in a modern R&D cleanroom environment with high-end semiconductor equipment, bridging science and industry through innovative research and technology development.

In this position, you will take ownership of technical tasks that are essential for keeping our cleanroom operations running reliably and efficiently. You will work closely with engineers, researchers, and external suppliers while continuously developing your technical skills in a highly innovative environment. Your contribution will directly support cutting-edge research and future technology development at SAL. 

Your future tasks include:
 * Independently carrying out maintenance, troubleshooting, and servicing of high-end cleanroom equipment
 * Planning and coordinating preventive and corrective maintenance activities on semiconductor tools
 * Supporting the continuous improvement of maintenance processes and equipment reliability within the cleanroom environment
 * Performing regular inspections of cleanroom facilities and infrastructure
 * Assisting the cleanroom team with daily operational and technical tasks
 * Preparing and maintaining technical documentation, maintenance records, and operating procedures
 * Working closely with equipment suppliers and process engineers to improve tool performance and support advanced process development
 * Coordinating service activities with external vendors as well as internal stakeholders
 * Supporting organizational and administrative activities within the team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations 

Your profile:
 * Completed apprenticeship or HTL degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a comparable technical field
 * At least 2 years of hands-on experience working in an ISO 4/5/6 cleanroom environment
 * Experience in servicing, troubleshooting, and maintaining cleanroom or semiconductor equipment
 * A reliable and motivated team player who is also able to work independently and solve technical challenges proactively
 * Ability to read and understand technical drawings, schematics, and service manuals 
 * Good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel); experience with AutoCAD or SolidWorks is a plus
 * Good communication skills in German and English
 * Comfortable working in an international and collaborative research environment where flexibility and teamwork are important 

Important Facts about SAL:
 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.
 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.
 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.
 * Internal and external training opportunities for career development.
 * Family & children friendly - actively shaping the compatibility of family and career.
 * "Vital4SAL" to promote a healthy workplace (e.g. SAL coaching pool, trainings on mental health, physical activities, healthy snacks, 24/7 accident insurance)
 * € 4 per day meal allowance in restaurants or € 2 per working day in supermarkets.
 * Public transport initiative (subsidy for the "Klimaticket")
 * Our values: Open door policy, flexibility in working hours, casual dress code, diverse teams, working with people of different nationalities, informal communication, lifelong learning, compatibility of family and career, sustainability, personal growth, and collective advancement.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group D (D1 salary = EUR 3.328, paid 14 times a year) based on 38,5 hours per week).

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful CAM & Product Engineering Team in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 CAM / Product Engineer In this position, you will work at the interface between customer requirements, product definition and manufacturing execution. Depending on your background and strengths, your main focus will be either Product Engineering or CAM Engineering, while working closely together within one integrated team.

The common goal is to ensure technically feasible, manufacturable solutions, stable production and high customer satisfaction throughout the entire product lifecycle.

 Your Responsibilities

Product Engineering Focus (Customer & Requirements)

 * Technical interface for customers and internal stakeholders

 * Evaluation and clarification of customer requirements and technical data

 * Assessment of technical feasibility in close coordination with CAM and production

 * Support of new customer projects and product introductions

 * Coordination and resolution of technical questions over the product and project lifecycle

 CAM Engineering Focus (Manufacturing & Data)

 * Creation of manufacturing-ready, machine-specific CAM data based on customer and Product Engineering input

 * Preparation and maintenance of production documentation according to systems and guidelines

 * Creation of AOI, drilling, laser drilling, routing and laser cutting programs including relevant data sheets

 * Netlist comparisons and data checks between customer original data and production data

 * Technical support for production data optimization and troubleshooting

 * Cross-site data support and preparation, including collaboration with international CAM teams

Your Profile

 * Completed technical education (HTL or comparable) and experience in the PCB or manufacturing industry

 * Technical understanding of manufacturing processes

 * Basic project management know-how

 * Very good German and English skills (spoken and written)

 * Team-oriented, structured and solution-driven working style

 * MS Office skills; SAP knowledge is an advantage

 Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value.

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities.

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

Your profile

 * Several years (typically 5+ years) of experience in substrate, PCB, or advanced packaging manufacturing or process development environments 
 * Experience working across R&D, engineering, experimental work and design of experiments (DoE), and production interfaces in a collaborative environment 
 * Experience in IC substrate manufacturing, HDI technologies, integration or prototyping is an advantage
 * Strong understanding of manufacturing and assembly processes in substrate or packaging environments 
 * Ability to translate technical concepts into feasible and stable process solutions under real production conditions 
 * Understanding of process sensitivities, tolerances, and material interactions in high-precision assemblies 
 * Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented way of working with a focus on implementation
 * Fluency in English
